title: PostgreSQL jobs and persistent webhook inbox
summary: Explicit pg-boss worker lifecycle and a PostgreSQL webhook inbox with byte-identity deduplication, expiring lease tokens, retries and dead states.

profiles: Node 24.19.0 + PGlite 0.5.8; TypeScript build and five tests executing PostgreSQL inbox SQL for uniqueness, collision, lease, retry/dead-state and completion behavior, plus actual pg-boss import/lifecycle guards.
notes: PGlite tests do not establish external PostgreSQL concurrency/failover or pg-boss worker execution; no external database or queue was started.
Apply inbox.sql deliberately and supply verified provider signatures/tenant identity before intake; handlers still need provider-side idempotency for external effects.
